dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature along the trailing edge from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological apex with a small pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Acute angular steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.2:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex curvature across the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum extending from the visible melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon transitions to the rostrum.
